items.title: After Tragedy, Zaliha Reverses Earlier Opposition To Health Service Commission
items.summary: In 2023, Zaliha Mustafa said forming a Health Service Commission won't solve MOH's issues and it lacks the power to improve health worker remuneration. But today, she wants it expedited because "we shouldn't wait until an issue receives public attention". The post After Tragedy, Zaliha Reverses Earlier Opposition To Health Service Commission appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: The Five Lights Extinguished In Long Lellang Tragedy
items.summary: Family, friends, coworkers, and patients pay tribute to Capt Zainol, Dr Ainul, SN Debra, SN Jessie, and MA Alexson, who died in the line of duty in their 30s and 40s on a Flying Doctor Service flight in Sarawak. They were remembered as dedicated workers. The post The Five Lights Extinguished In Long Lellang Tragedy appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Hartal Demands FDS Suspension, MNU Wants Memorial For Crash Victims
items.summary: Hartal Doktor Kontrak demands a temporary suspension of the Flying Doctor Service (FDS), pending full safety checks. The Malayan Nurses Union tells MOH to organise a memorial or official tribute to the five people killed in the FDS helicopter crash. The post Hartal Demands FDS Suspension, MNU Wants Memorial For Crash Victims appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.summary: The arrival of nirsevimab, a long-acting monoclonal antibody, promises to rewrite the narrative of RSV prevention. The post Game Changer For Infant Health — Dr Musa Mohd Nordin & Dr Husna Musa appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Sarawak Gives RM100,000 To Each Family Of FDS Helicopter Crash Victims, Sponsors Children’s Education
items.summary: The Sarawak state government is donating RM100,000 to each family of the five victims killed in a Flying Doctor Service helicopter crash, besides fully bearing the education fees of their school-going children. Their deaths are a loss to all Sarawakians. The post Sarawak Gives RM100,000 To Each Family Of FDS Helicopter Crash Victims, Sponsors Children’s Education appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: MOH ‘Doubles Down’ On Flying Doctor Service Despite Scant Details On Safety
items.summary: Dr Dzul says MOH will "double down" on its Flying Doctor Service (FDS) for universal health coverage, even though he couldn't provide technical safety details on its helicopters. FDS aircraft are contracted. MOH has proposed raising the RM30 allowance. The post MOH ‘Doubles Down’ On Flying Doctor Service Despite Scant Details On Safety appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Government Can’t Use Indemnity Shield If FDS Helicopter Crash Involved Negligence: MP
items.summary: Bandar Kuching MP Dr Kelvin Yii tells the government not to use indemnity forms signed by staff as a shield if negligence is found in the fatal FDS helicopter crash. Senator Dr Lingeshwaran says the chopper model, built in 1991, was fully retired in 2001. The post Government Can’t Use Indemnity Shield If FDS Helicopter Crash Involved Negligence: MP appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: FDS Helicopter Crash Sparks Anger: Indemnity Form, RM30 Allowance
items.summary: The fatal crash of a Flying Doctor Service helicopter has sparked widespread anger over the RM30 allowance for health workers, an indemnity form, and age of the aircraft. A doctor who served on FDS says he didn't get insurance or aviation safety training. The post FDS Helicopter Crash Sparks Anger: Indemnity Form, RM30 Allowance appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: How Public-Private-Community Partnership Gets HIV Patients Access To Treatment In Sabah, Sarawak
items.summary: In Sabah and Sarawak, a partnership model between the government, Sunway Group, and Malaysian AIDS Foundation is helping patients overcome poverty, distance, and transport costs to stay on life-saving HIV treatment. The post How Public-Private-Community Partnership Gets HIV Patients Access To Treatment In Sabah, Sarawak appeared first on CodeBlue .
